theme_and_identity.emotional_tone: Sophisticated, Trustworthy, High-Performance, Luxury meets Swiss Clarity
theme_and_identity.description: A top-tier SaaS ERP MVP for real estate brokerages (imobiliárias), featuring CRM pipelines, deep analytics, and multi-tenant management. Must feel like a high-end financial or luxury real estate tool, completely avoiding generic 'AI startup' slop.

headings.rules: Used for all H1-H4. Must use tracking-tight for H1-H2. H1 max text-5xl.

body.rules: Highly legible geometric sans for data grids, labels, and standard text.

mono.rules: Used for IDs, numerical KPIs, and technical data.

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing. Containers with borders must have internal padding p-6 or p-8.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: Collapsible sidebar. Fixed width 280px when open, 80px when closed. Should feature grouped modules.
spacing_and_layout.topbar: Sticky header (z-50) with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-[#0A0C0B]/70). Must contain breadcrumbs, global search, notifications, and user menu.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid Pattern for KPIs. 4 columns on desktop (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4). Tight gap (gap-6) for high-density. Summary cards span 1, charts span 2 or 3.
spacing_and_layout.crm_kanban: Horizontal scrolling flex container with gap-6. Each column represents a deal stage. Cards inside columns use cursor-grab and subtle hover lift.
spacing_and_layout.corners: Subtle roundness. Use rounded-lg (8px) globally to maintain a professional, sharp aesthetic.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no massive drop shadows. Hover states should feature a slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-md.
components.buttons: Rounded-md. Primary buttons use the deep forest green in light mode, with white text. NEVER use generic blue. Hover states must transition cleanly.
components.tables: Dense rows using TanStack Table. Left-align text, right-align numbers. Hover states on rows: bg-muted/50. 1px border-b per row.
components.forms: Inputs use rounded-md, 1px border. Focus states: ring-2 ring-primary/30. Floating labels or clean top labels. NO native datepickers (use Shadcn Calendar).
components.empty_states: Centered content with a subtle Lucide icon (stroke-width 1.5, text-muted-foreground), clear heading, and primary CTA. Max width 400px.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for Sticky Headers. Light: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-border/50. Dark: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0C0B]/70 border-b border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + direct shadows. Very soft and diffuse.
visual_enhancers.charts: recharts. Use customized tooltips with dark background and small text. Remove standard grid lines, use dashed lines or none.
visual_enhancers.motion: Use framer-motion for page transitions and staggering list items. transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.

implementation_notes_for_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS variables for colors to natively support Light and Dark themes via 'next-themes' or manual class on html.
Map the provided hex codes to HSL in index.css (e.g., :root { --background: 144 10% 97%; } and .dark { --background: 150 10% 4%; }).
Avoid generic AI slop. The dashboard should look like a highly functional, expensive ERP. Do NOT use purple gradients.
Do NOT center align the app container. Ensure left alignment for all data tables and main content.
Use Shadcn UI extensively. Write the components in Javascript (.jsx/.js files), as no TS is used.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
For 'TV Mode', provide a view that hides sidebar/topbar and scales up KPIs fullscreen with dark mode forcefully active.
Multi-tenant seletor de empresa (Company selector) should be prominently placed at the top of the sidebar.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text.
accessibility.focus: All actionable items must have a focus ring: focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:ring-offset-2.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Always use modern button styles, crisp edges, minimal border radius (max 8px).
NEVER use generic placeholder images (via.placeholder.com etc.), only use the ones provided in the images section.
All components must be .js/.jsx, do not generate .tsx files.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or dropdowns. Always use solid or heavily blurred backgrounds.
